title: Saray Boses ed Abay na Ag-onkikiwas a Danum
intro: Ilitrato pa so sakey a komunidad ya ag-inngaran ed sakey a syudad odino manuley, noagta lapud mareen a danum a kawalaan na bilay. Pigpigara labat a bersikulo so makanonot ed sayan komunidad, ya lanang ya nilista ed saramay ag-angawat na panangigiya. Dengel mo legan iran mansasalita manlapud ag-amta.
clues: Sakey itayon komunidad ya inngaran ed Quran, balet say interon istorya tayo et mansiansian akatabon ed misteryo.
Naynay kamin nabitla ed abay na saramay angiburi, a singa saray totoo nen Ad tan Thamud.
Sikami so tatawagen ya saray Kaiba na Ar-Rass, say Bobon ya akasinger so bilay mi.
Imburi mi so mensahero ya imbaki ed sikami a walaan na malinew a panangigiya.
Nibilang kami ed saramay angipulisay ed amin ya mensahero ya imbaki nen Allah.
Inarap mi so panamasegsegang ya nasumpal sumpad balang sakey ya mangiburi ed arap mi, kadederal parad pangipulisay ed sikami.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
